question: Let \(ABCDEF\) be a regular hexagon with side length \(1.\) Denote by \(X,\) \(Y,\) and \(Z\) the midpoints of sides \(AB,\) \(CD,\) and \(EF,\) respectively. What is the area of the convex hexagon whose interior is the intersection of the interiors of \(\triangle ACE\) and \(\triangle XYZ?\)
solution:
We can find the intersection by removing three small corner triangles from \(\triangle XYZ\).

Let \(O\) be the center of the regular hexagon. Joining \(O\) to all six vertices produces six equilateral triangles of side \(1\). Thus \(B,O,E\) are collinear and \(BE=2\).

In trapezoid \(FABE\), the parallel sides \(FA\) and \(BE\) have lengths \(1\) and \(2\). The segment \(XZ\) joins the midpoints of the other two sides, so
\[
XZ=\frac{1+2}{2}=\frac32,
\qquad XZ\parallel BE.
\]
Rotation through \(120^\circ\) about \(O\) cycles \(X,Y,Z\), so \(\triangle XYZ\) is equilateral with side \(3/2\). Also, \(XY\) is the midline of trapezoid \(ABCD\), giving \(XY\parallel BC\).

Let \(U_1\) be where \(AC\) crosses \(XZ\), and let \(U_2\) be where \(AC\) crosses \(XY\). The corner removed at \(X\) is \(\triangle XU_1U_2\).

Because \(AB=BC\) and \(\angle ABC=120^\circ\), we have \(\angle BAC=30^\circ\). Using \(XY\parallel BC\), triangle \(AXU_2\) has angles \(30^\circ,120^\circ,30^\circ\). Its equal sides therefore give
\[
XU_2=AX=\frac12.
\]
The diagonal \(BE\) bisects \(\angle ABC\). Since \(XZ\parallel BE\), we get \(\angle U_1XU_2=60^\circ\). The angle at \(U_2\) is \(30^\circ\), so \(\triangle XU_1U_2\) is a \(30^\circ\)-\(60^\circ\)-\(90^\circ\) triangle with hypotenuse \(1/2\). Its legs are \(1/4\) and \(\sqrt3/4\), and its area is
\[
\frac12\cdot\frac14\cdot\frac{\sqrt3}{4}=\frac{\sqrt3}{32}.
\]

Sides \(AC,CE,EA\) cut off the corners at \(X,Y,Z\), respectively. These three disjoint corner triangles are congruent by the same rotational symmetry. Hence the requested area is
\[
\frac{\sqrt3}{4}\left(\frac32\right)^2
-3\left(\frac{\sqrt3}{32}\right)
=\frac{9\sqrt3}{16}-\frac{3\sqrt3}{32}
=\boxed{\frac{15\sqrt3}{32}}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\text{C}\).
